summary: This directory defines the core data models and type interfaces required to represent the static structure and metadata of a software package, providing a foundational schema for capturing file-level exports, directory hierarchies, and project dependency relationships.
responsibilities: Define schemas for package metadata and static code analysis
Model the structural composition of modules and exported symbols
Represent dependency relationships between source files and external modules
Provide a unified structure for capturing project directory hierarchies
relationships: Package metadata provides the high-level context for understanding dependency analysis and module composition.
Exported symbols are mapped to specific modules to define the public interface of the package structure.
Dependency analysis informs the relationship between local modules and the external requirements defined within the package metadata.
designDecisions: Uses TypeScript interfaces to enforce strong typing for analysis schemas
Implements an index-based entry point to centralize access to core analytical models
Organizes data structures by domain context to support modular and consistent consumption
